relationships.subject: pIRES/VEGF165/HGF bicistronic plasmid
relationships.evidence_quote: Mean VEGF serum levels, as presented in Table 1, increased significantly from 235 ± 83 to 398 ± 78 pg/L (p < 0.001) 1 month after gene therapy.

relationships.subject: pIRES/VEGF165/HGF bicistronic plasmid
relationships.evidence_quote: There was significant decrease of pain in group 1: from 6.7 ± 1.4 to 1.3 ± 1.1 3 months after plasmid injections (p < 0.002).

relationships.subject: HGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Some studies report that presence of HGF in extracellular matrix multiplies the activity of VEGF during angiogenesis [2, 20, 25].

key_findings: Intramuscular VEGF165/HGF bicistronic plasmid raised serum VEGF, ankle-brachial index and collateral vessels and reduced rest pain in CLI with diabetes.
